The bidder should be a regular servicing firm for the work of Maintenance of Deaerator / Turbine auxiliaries of 210 MW or above. As a proof bidder shall enclose copy of Work Order for having carried out the work of Maintenance of Deaerator / Turbine auxiliaries of 210 MW or above. For which Bidder shall upload Work orders.

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar work such as Maintenance of Deaerator / Turbine auxiliaries of 210 MW or above, of value not less than Rs. 5.61 Lakhs in the last five years in any thermal power stations. As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload single work order and corresponding work done certificates /MOM /invoice copies/ certificates issued by competent authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 11.22 Lakhs, in at least two financial years during the last five years. As a proof of this the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Financial Turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited)
